title: Prostate cANcer graDe Assessment challenge
description: Digitized prostate-biopsy slides with source-provided data-provider, ISUP-grade, Gleason-score, and partial mask labels.

access.reason: Kaggle requires sign-in and acceptance of competition rules. The 411.9 GB dataset is not eligible for unattended registry acquisition.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International
license.scope: The PANDA publication and current challenge data page state the non-commercial share-alike licence. Kaggle competition rules also apply to access.
license.redistribution: No registry copy is made. A future acquisition requires explicit operator acceptance of Kaggle terms and must preserve the non-commercial, attribution, and share-alike conditions.

citation: Bulten, W. et al. Artificial intelligence for diagnosis and Gleason grading of prostate cancer: the PANDA challenge. Nature Medicine 28, 154-163 (2022). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-021-01620-2

known_scale.basis: Kaggle reports 411.9 GB; the publication reports 10,616 development slides. No registry bytes were acquired.
